facts.label: Mode of examination
facts.notes: Confirmed through official-domain search results for GATE 2026 and 2027.

facts.label: Number of questions
facts.notes: All three official DA answer keys (2024–2026) list exactly 65 questions.

facts.label: Total marks
facts.notes: The marks column of each official DA key sums to 100.

facts.label: General Aptitude
facts.value: 15 marks: Q.1–Q.5 carry 1 mark each, Q.6–Q.10 carry 2 marks each (common to all GATE papers)
facts.notes: The per-question marks come from the official keys; the 'common to all papers' statement is from the official website and brochure.

facts.label: DA subject section
facts.value: 85 marks: Q.11–Q.35 carry 1 mark each (25 questions), Q.36–Q.65 carry 2 marks each (30 questions). DA has no separate Engineering Mathematics section.
facts.notes: The per-question marks come from the official keys; the brochure lists DA among the papers split into GA 15 and subject 85.

facts.label: Question types
facts.value: MCQ (exactly one of four options correct), MSQ (one or more of four options correct), NAT (numerical answer entered with a virtual keypad; no options)
facts.notes: All three types appear in every DA paper from 2024 to 2026.

facts.label: Negative marking: MCQ
facts.value: Wrong answer to a 1-mark MCQ: −1/3; wrong answer to a 2-mark MCQ: −2/3
facts.notes: Confirmed for GATE 2026 through official-domain search results. No indication of a change for 2027 was found.

facts.label: Partial marking
facts.value: None. For an MSQ, full marks require choosing every correct option and no wrong option.

facts.label: NAT answer ranges
facts.value: Official keys give NAT answers as a range (e.g. '0.12 to 0.13'); any response within the range receives full marks

facts.label: Calculator
facts.value: A virtual on-screen scientific calculator is provided; physical calculators are not allowed

facts.label: Score validity
facts.value: 3 years from the announcement of results

facts.label: GATE 2027 examination dates (provisional)
facts.value: February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20 and 21, 2027; forenoon and afternoon sessions. Results expected 19 March 2027. The official site marks these dates as liable to change.
facts.notes: The date-wise schedule for the DA paper had not been found at the time of verification. Check the official GATE 2027 website.
